/Title: Test feature comparisons with numeric adjusted P values only
/Subject: Numeric bracket labels are Bonferroni-adjusted P values for 11 two-sided paired t-tests over ten folds. Each fold uses a five-seed ensemble. Fold-level inference exploratory due to overlapping training sets. User-specified seven-color palette, repeated in model order: #FEFCFA, #B7BEC9, #4D5058, #F5DCD1, #F0BDBD, #928C95, #B2CEF7. Exact opaque RGB fills; original gray outlines retained. Boxplots median/IQR, whiskers 1.5 IQR; combinations are not one nested feature path. User-requested legend rename: T: TF binding site (2). The same two CTCF-derived features are retained; this is a display-name change only. Display-only user override: the two adjusted P=1 labels (BPQ-BPQE and BPQI-BPQIT) are shown as N/A; these are not missing or uncomputed statistics. Original numeric results retained in Keywords.
